source: https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Fear_Mongerer (2026-09-03 更新); 交叉核对 https://hypixel-skyblock.fandom.com/wiki/Fear_Mongerer (一致)
note: 惊魂节期间村庄里的糖果商人,只在夜里营业。招呼客人时是正经的活动说明;Abiphone 里则是个嫌你烦、脾气不好的夜猫子(别大白天吵醒我)。花园访客台词在 Farming/NPC_Message/Fear_Mongerer.json。
source_note: 两家 Wiki 台词一致,均无实测;网页没有可信的颜色信息,不写 raw/segments。

messages.text: During the Spooky Festival, you can collect Candy by killing mobs or fishing.
messages.zh: 惊魂节期间,击杀生物或钓鱼都能收集糖果。

messages.text: I accept Candy in exchange for exclusively spooky items!
messages.zh: 拿糖果来,我给你换独家的惊魂物品!

messages.text: Each Spooky Festival, the top Candy-collecting players can earn even spookier rewards!
messages.zh: 每届惊魂节,糖果收得最多的玩家还能拿到更惊悚的奖励!

messages.text: Click me again to open my shop.
messages.zh: 再点我一下,打开我的商店。

messages.text: ✆ You want to be able to call me anytime?
messages.zh: ✆ 你想随时都能给我打电话?

messages.text: ✆ Well that's not possible, I'm only available at night.
messages.zh: ✆ 那可不行,我只在晚上出没。

messages.text: ✆ If you give me 64 Purple Candy and 6 Ectoplasm, I might give you my contact.
messages.gloss: Purple Candy → 紫色糖果,Ectoplasm → 灵质(物品名由通用词组成)。
messages.zh: ✆ 给我 64 个紫色糖果和 6 个灵质,我也许会把联系方式给你。

messages.text: ✆ Mhm... Your face just isn't very scary...
messages.zh: ✆ 嗯……你这张脸实在不怎么吓人……

messages.text: ✆ But it's not your fault I suppose, here take my contact.
messages.zh: ✆ 不过这也怪不得你,拿去吧,我的联系方式。

messages.text: ✆ Listen buddy it's not because I gave you my contact that it gives you the right to wake me up in the middle of the day.
messages.zh: ✆ 听着伙计,我把联系方式给了你,不代表你就能大白天把我吵醒。

messages.text: ✆ Call me back tonight or I'm blocking you.
messages.zh: ✆ 今晚再打,不然我拉黑你。
